8. Season-wise Team Dominance Heatmap¶

9. Key Insights Summary¶

============================================================
  IPL EDA -- KEY INSIGHTS
============================================================

1. Best batting average (>=20 innings): B Sai Sudharsan (49.24)
2. Most economical bowler (>=300 balls): A Kumble (Eco: 6.77)
3. Best win rate team:  Rajasthan Royals (54.3% from 129 games)
4. Strike rate: Season 2007 avg SR = 106.3 --> Season 2024 avg SR = 127.0
5. Boundary %: 13.3% -> 16.0% over dataset.

Correlation key findings:
  * Runs scored is highly correlated with balls faced.
  * Strike rate and boundary % are positively correlated.
  * Batting average shows weaker SR correlation -- anchors can average high.
============================================================
